svg.title: Depression scores at the end of the big GLP-1 weight trials
svg.desc: PHQ-9 depression scores, scale 0 to 27, at the end of treatment. Semaglutide 2.4 mg, pooled STEP 1 to 3 trials, week 68: 2.0 on drug versus 2.4 on placebo. Tirzepatide, pooled SURMOUNT-1 to 3, week 72: 1.9 versus 2.4. Both are in the none-to-minimal range. These trials excluded people with recent major depression, and the PHQ-9 is a depression scale, not a direct measure of pleasure or zest.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both groups stayed in the “none or minimal” band (0–4).
